task: rtl/div16.sv is an unsigned 16/8 divider with a start/done handshake (divide-by-zero: q=FFFF, r=a[7:0]). Make it meet 2.6 ns with <= 2800 um^2 on sky130hd. Latency up to 20 cycles is allowed; busy is high while working; operands are only valid in the start cycle. Keep the port list. tb/tb_smoke_div.sv is the block's smoke test.
